hero.title: Your fashion business, run from one place.
hero.description: A store page, orders, shipping labels and payouts in one console, built for tailors, designers and fabric sellers. Free to join. You pay 10% only when you sell.

features.title: Everything a fashion business needs, already built

items.title: Instant storefront
items.text: Your own store page with your cover, logo and colours, and a link for your bio.

items.title: Flexible selling
items.text: Ready to wear, made to order with priced styles, fabric by the yard or the piece.

items.title: Ship smarter
items.text: Confirm the order, print the label, and the courier collects from you.

items.title: Quote requests
items.text: Customers design outfits in the studio and send them to you to price.

items.title: Chat with customers
items.text: A chat with the customer on every bespoke order while you make it.

items.title: Customers and measurements
items.text: Each order arrives with the measurements it needs, checked before checkout.

items.title: Payments
items.text: See what you earn on every order, and withdraw to your bank when it's ready.

items.title: Market intelligence
items.text: A dashboard, a business assistant that knows your store, and a weekly digest.

money.title: Free to join. 10% when you sell.
money.description: No monthly fee and no listing fee. Every order shows the commission and what you earn before you ship, and delivery is paid by the customer.
points: Earnings ready 14 days after the customer pays
Withdraw to your bank whenever you like

steps.title: From sign-up to your first payout

items.title: Create your vendor account
items.text: Sign up for a store in the vendor console.

items.title: Verify your business
items.text: A quick check of your business details, done from the console.

items.title: Set up your store
items.text: Add your cover photo, logo, store colour and the address of your store page.

items.title: List your pieces
items.text: Ready to wear, made to order, fabric or accessories. A checklist shows what each listing needs.

items.title: Confirm orders and print the label
items.text: Confirm within 24 hours, make or pack it, then tap Fulfill Order and print the label.

items.title: The courier collects
items.text: The customer is updated at every scan until it's delivered.

items.title: Get paid
items.text: Your earnings reach your wallet 14 days after the customer paid. Withdraw to your bank.

audience.title: If you make or sell fashion, it's built for you

items.title: Tailors
items.text: Made-to-measure orders and bespoke quotes, with the measurements attached.

items.title: Fashion designers
items.text: Ready-to-wear collections and made-to-order pieces with your own styles.

items.title: Fabric sellers
items.text: Sell by the yard or the piece, to shoppers and to tailors.

items.title: Accessory makers
items.text: Bags, caps and jewellery in every colour and size you make.

closing.title: Your store is waiting.
closing.description: Join the waitlist and we'll let you know as soon as your place opens.
